messages:
maya: rooftop hang tonight? also need a 40-ish minute laid-back playlist (no EDM or metal) + one short doc (<=60min) recs. sunny & chatter vibe. :sun_with_face:
eli: my go-to 40m rooftop set (acoustic / mellow):
1. Nick Mulvey - Cucurucu (3:30)
2. José González - Crosses (3:12)
3. Hozier - Like Real People Do (3:15)
4. Madeleine Peyroux - Dance Me to the End of Love (4:00)
5. Gregory Alan Isakov - Big Black Car (4:35)
6. Agnes Obel - Riverside (3:12)
7. Leon Bridges - River (3:35)
8. The Small Glories - Wichitah Woman (4:20)
9. Sam Beam & Jesca Hoop - Four Peaks (6:00)

maya: love this. totals ~36-38 min, good for sunset + chat.
cho: short doc rec: "The Pollinators" (indie short, ~52min)  small, sweet, great convo starter about bees and city gardens.
samir: or "A Year With The Birds" (~48min) if you want something quieter and visual.
jukebox-bot: queued eli's rooftop set to #random-playlists (link: https://open.spotify/placeholder). reminder set for 2024-06-12T19:30:00Z. :cd::alarm_clock:
maya: vote: bees doc (:one:) or birds doc (:two:)? react with :one: or :two:
cho: :one:
eli: :two: trying to be different
samir: :one: excited for bees chat
maya: :one: wins. rooftop + bee doc tonight at 7:30. bring a drink and maybe a tiny portable speaker. :)
eli: i'll bring iced tea and a playlist on vinyl (if weather holds).
cho: i'll bring citronella candles.
jukebox-bot: reminder re-confirmed for 2024-06-12T19:00:00Z  send weather update 1h before. :sun_behind_rain_cloud:
